title_en: Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Issues Concerning the Application of Law in Handling Criminal Cases of Illegal Manufacturing, Trading, and Transporting of Non-Military Guns and Ammunition

articles.content_en:
I. Whoever illegally manufactures, purchases, sells, or transports non-military firearms, major components of non-military firearms, or their special ammunition, if the act constitutes a crime, shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the provisions of Article 112 of the Criminal Law.
Non-military firearms refer to shooting sports guns, hunting guns, anesthetic injection guns, air guns, steel ball guns, tear gas guns, stun guns, and other guns sufficient to cause casualties or make people lose consciousness.

III. If the quantity of illegally manufactured, purchased, sold, or transported non-military firearms or ammunition reaches five times or more the minimum quantity standards set forth in Article 2 of this Interpretation, or if there are other serious circumstances, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than seven years or life imprisonment in accordance with Article 112 of the Criminal Law.

IV. If the circumstances of illegally manufacturing, purchasing, selling, or transporting non-military firearms or ammunition are especially serious, or if serious consequences are caused, the offender shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of Item 4 of Article 1 of the Decision of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on Severely Punishing Criminals Who Seriously Endanger Public Security.
September 20, 1995.
